search_window.basis: Previous verified Care Line heartbeat completed_at through the current run. Retrospective candidates are considered for newly recovered high-value missed events; actual source dates are preserved and prior recorded/reviewed items excluded.

findings.title: Waybridge Clinics to end behavioral-health patient care at Omaha site October 30
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Our last day of patient care is Friday, October 30, 2026.
findings.service_line: Outpatient mental health care; provider notice additionally references TMS, Spravato and IV ketamine treatment series
findings.access_consequences: The Omaha behavioral-health clinic is no longer accepting new patients and says October 30, 2026 is its final day of patient care. Existing patients must arrange care elsewhere; provider offers medical-record transfers, referral options and medication bridging where appropriate. Completion of last-day operations has not yet been confirmed.
findings.affected_population: Current and prospective behavioral-health patients of the Omaha clinic; patient counts unknown.
findings.evidence_notes: Direct, accessible undated Waybridge Clinics closure notice identifies 17021 Lakeside Hills Plaza, Suite 203, Omaha, NE 68130 and final care date. Found in this run, not found in reviewed Care Line watch ledger for Oct 27-29 or immediate prior Oct 30 run. Announcement time is unknown, and this run precedes the stated last day's conclusion. Production duplicate checks remain authoritative.

coverage_notes.limitations: CMS official notices latest October 23; targeted search coverage is bounded and indexing can lag. The Waybridge primary-source webpage supplies no publication or announcement timestamp; the confirmed final care date is October 30, not proof that last-day appointments have finished. Both geographically distinct site closures arise from one provider notice. Geographic and production deduplication remain for review; no independent production collector changes.
